about: Mishra Dhatu Nigam Ltd (MIDHANI) manufactures superalloys, titanium, special purpose steel and other special metals. [1] It was incorporated in 1973 at Hyderabad as a Government of India Enterprise under the Ministry of Defence. [2] GoI still owns ~74% stake in the company after its IPO in 2018. [3]
